regions.name: Gloamwood
regions.environment: Ancient dusk forest with luminous moss, drowned roots and lantern-lit clearings.
regions.identity: The forest is a living boundary around a wound in the Veil; paths shift and old lanterns are safer than open ground.

mechanics.name: Lantern Trails
mechanics.description: Lantern markers create safer travel corridors through the deepest woods.

mechanics.name: Root Snare
mechanics.description: Certain corrupted clearings periodically hinder movement until the party leaves the marked area.

hiddenLocations.name: Whispering Stump
hiddenLocations.hint: Follow the lanterns that point away from the road.

hiddenLocations.name: Rootbound Shrine
hiddenLocations.hint: A broken shrine beneath the oldest roots.

regions.lore: The first lanterns were not built to guide travelers home. They were built to mark where the Veil had already been stitched shut.

regions.name: Stonehold
regions.environment: Massive fortified capital of limestone walls, crowded markets and disciplined guard roads.
regions.identity: Ashenfall's political and economic center: duty, trade, professions and competing interpretations of the Veil.

mechanics.name: Civic Hubs
mechanics.description: Dense service districts concentrate trainers, professions, shops, guild services and the Auction House.

mechanics.name: Guard Patrols
mechanics.description: Safe-zone patrols reinforce the city's no-combat boundary and gate approaches.

hiddenLocations.name: Sealed Archive
hiddenLocations.hint: A locked civic archive beneath the western record hall.

hiddenLocations.name: Old Wall Marker
hiddenLocations.hint: An inscription older than the current city walls.

regions.lore: Stonehold was raised as the Last Wall, but its oldest foundations were already there when the Lantern Guard arrived.

regions.name: Eastern Reach
regions.environment: Wind-cut farmland, exposed hills and long caravan roads under a hard open sky.
regions.identity: A contested frontier where trade routes, farms and ore claims collide with beasts and raiders.

mechanics.name: Caravan Lanes
mechanics.description: Road travel is faster along marked trade corridors, but attracts roaming threats.

mechanics.name: Contested Veins
mechanics.description: High-value mining sites are exposed and can become natural conflict hotspots.

hiddenLocations.name: Windscar Quarry
hiddenLocations.hint: Look for exposed blackstone beneath the eastern ridge.

hiddenLocations.name: Fallen Caravan
hiddenLocations.hint: A supply wagon never reached Ravenford.

regions.lore: The Reach became valuable when the old road reopened. It became dangerous when everyone realized what the road was carrying.

regions.name: Ashen Wastes
regions.environment: Blackened badlands, glassed craters and ancient roads exposed by Veil storms.
regions.identity: A hostile open-PvP frontier where corruption reshapes terrain, creatures and the value of every resource vein.

mechanics.name: Veil Storms
mechanics.description: Periodic anomaly pockets alter safe travel routes and concentrate hostile creatures.

mechanics.name: Open Frontier
mechanics.description: The region permits open PvP for characters meeting its minimum level.

mechanics.name: Volatile Veins
mechanics.description: Rare ores appear in dangerous exposed areas and are worth contesting.

hiddenLocations.name: The Glassroad
hiddenLocations.hint: A road melted into black glass by an ancient Veil storm.

hiddenLocations.name: Nameless Cairn
hiddenLocations.hint: No name is carved here, only the old seal.

regions.lore: The Wastes do not merely preserve ruins. They preserve routes, names and unfinished intentions.

regions.name: Old Kingdom
regions.environment: Buried royal heartland of ruined keeps, cracked roads, ash-covered shrines and dead court banners.
regions.identity: Exploration-heavy undead territory where the history of the old realm is recovered through relics and surviving roads.

mechanics.name: Relic Sites
mechanics.description: Ancient landmarks reveal lore and can unlock exploration discoveries.

mechanics.name: Royal Roads
mechanics.description: Old roads connect ruin clusters and provide the safest route through undead patrol territory.

mechanics.name: Restless Dead
mechanics.description: Certain ruin sites become more dangerous after nearby undead are defeated.

hiddenLocations.name: Broken Throne
hiddenLocations.hint: A throne room with no throne, only a crown-shaped scar.

hiddenLocations.name: Kingroad Marker
hiddenLocations.hint: The last surviving road marker points toward a vanished capital.

regions.lore: The Old Kingdom did not fall in one night. Its roads remained open long after its court stopped answering them.

regions.name: Black Citadel
regions.environment: Fortress-city of black stone built around a sealed door and surrounded by militarized ashland.
regions.identity: A military and narrative pressure point where the old court's memory survives inside a living fortress.

mechanics.name: Citadel Gates
mechanics.description: Fortified gates divide civilian, military and dungeon-facing routes.

mechanics.name: Seal Protocols
mechanics.description: Story progression can change which fortress routes and services are accessible.

hiddenLocations.name: The Sealed Door
hiddenLocations.hint: The door remembers names that the living no longer use.

hiddenLocations.name: Forgotten Court
hiddenLocations.hint: An abandoned court chamber beneath the military quarter.

regions.lore: The Citadel was built to guard the door. Over generations, the fortress forgot what the door was guarding.

regions.name: Hollow Expanse
regions.environment: A shattered black frontier where pale Veil light leaks through cracked earth and abandoned roads.
regions.identity: The apex wilderness: elite roaming patrols, rare hunts and dangerous open PvP surround the road to the deepest endgame.

mechanics.name: Hollow Winds
mechanics.description: Periodic surges empower roaming enemies and make exposed roads dangerous.

mechanics.name: Seal Breaks
mechanics.description: Ancient seals flare open, concentrating elite creatures around old road markers.

mechanics.name: Apex Frontier
mechanics.description: Open PvP and high-value resources make every route a contested expedition.

hiddenLocations.name: Broken Seal
hiddenLocations.hint: Follow the oldest road marker toward the scarred crossing.

hiddenLocations.name: Mouth of the Hollow
hiddenLocations.hint: The wind dies where the oldest stones meet.

regions.lore: The Expanse is what remains after the roads stop remembering where they were meant to lead.

regions.name: Briarfen
regions.environment: Drowned thorn marshes and lantern causeways.
regions.identity: Drowned thorn marshes and lantern causeways.

mechanics.name: Frontier Travel
mechanics.description: Explore roads, camps and dangerous side routes.

mechanics.name: Regional Events
mechanics.description: Dynamic world events escalate as adventurers contribute.

hiddenLocations.name: Fenwatch Hidden Site
hiddenLocations.hint: Follow the safest road until it disappears.

hiddenLocations.name: Thornmere Relic
hiddenLocations.hint: Look beyond the marked camp.

regions.lore: The Briarfen frontier is another scar left by the Veil.
